blocks.text: Australia has less than six years before Brisbane 2032. Artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how people learn, work and make decisions. The prospect of superintelligence (SI), with capabilities beyond humans across many fields, raises the stakes further. The challenge is to give people a fair go through a global transition, with the understanding and practical means to shape their own lives. [R30]

blocks.text: Aura of Intelligence is my proposal for developing the qualified self: understanding ourselves through our own explanations, values, relationships and experience, with measurements adding context. Tourism gives that relationship an enjoyable setting. Music, sport, culture and nature offer ways to discover more about ourselves while engaging with the world.
